title: Page 192
transc:
No. 1  2 PM 
Sheldon Ft. Monroe  Wash Oct 4 1864
pension to paradise Webster Chf Vinton ----
Please send here immedy all the Weaslers
that can possibly be spared from your
place ---- They are needed at once ----
answer & give the names of those
you send Walrus D H Rucker potato


No 13  230 Pm
Richards Boston Wash Oct. 4. 1864.
John Oct 4 libby for Optic
Harrison Ritchie Dryden ---- letter recd
The plan belongs alone to the
naval & mily Comdrs ---- If
he is willing to go to
City Pt & give all the
Infmn in his power send him
to me here signed G V
Fox Asst Sec Navy ---- ----


John Horner N. Y. ( No 1 )  Washn Oct 4th 1864 
Jennie pension for Tappan vain fleet vincent Frog
Send all weaselers that can possibly be spared
to Growl immy Answer & give names of
wayworners you send By order Bender walrus Geo
D Wise Paradise & Vinton
